Zonal Offices.

Sub:- Review of 14B Inquiries pending for more than 1 year-Reg.

Sir/Madam,

In the cadre-restructuring exercise, Zonal Offices (ZOs) were envisaged as an

extended arm of the Head Office and were expected to monitor and review all functional
areas in their respective Zones. But it is regretted to note that ZOs have not been
conducting any review of the pendency in the Zone-- be it 7A, 14B or Recovery matters.
A detailed circular for monitoring of 7A proceedings has already been issued vide letter
no. Compliance/2020-2021/7-A Cases dated 19.08.2021.

2.

Accordingly, it is reiterated that ACC-in-charge of ZO shall:

. review all 14B cases pending for over 5 years on fortnightly basis and furnish the

details of such cases to Head Office along with the names of assessing officer,
the reasons of pendency and the action taken by the Adjudicating Officer to
dispose them within the time period stipulated by the Head Office guidelines
issued from time to time, the specific remarks of their respective supervisory
officer regarding the efforts made by them to ensure compliance with the HO
guidelines:

_ ensure time-bound disposal of all 14B cases pending for more than three years

by 30.09.2021 and ali 14B cases pending for more than one year by 31.12.2021,
and

. advise all Adjudicating Officer within their jurisdiction to complete the 14B

inquiries in a time-bound manner considering the provisions of the section 128 of
the Code on Social Security, 2020.

3. In case, it is observed that an officer is not adhering to the above guidelines, the
continuity of such officer in Compliance functions may be reviewed and necessary
remedial administrative actions including the disciplinary actions may be taken and/or
recommended to Head Office.

4. A comprehensive report in this regard along with specific recommendations of
ACC-in-charge of the ZO and the actions taken/contemplated against the erring officers
may also be furnished to the Head Office by 31 .08.2021.

Yours faithfully,
AN Sf
(Jag Mohan)

Addl. Central PF Commissioner (HQ) (Compliance, Recovery & Legal)
